scientific_limitations_and_integrity: The proof covers every idempotent of every finite full-support binary relation monoid, and realizes all finite groups; it does not enumerate idempotents or optimize carrier sizes. Related classical results for the larger full relation monoid are credited as antecedents, not new. Preston 1973 and Brandon–Hardy–Markowsky 1972 were available as abstracts/metadata only; an equivalent older full-support construction cannot be excluded, and no priority guarantee or independent certification is claimed.
title: Maximal subgroups of finite multipermutation monoids via Boolean row semilattices
